about: Release public keys (docs/contract/UPDATES.md section 3). A build's anchors are generated from this file: firmware environments take the production keys only, the simulated boards and native tests the test key. The test key is derived from a public label (SHA-256 of the label is its seed) and is valid nowhere. No production key exists yet, so firmware builds have no anchors and refuse every update.

keys.label: mecon-firmware public test key: release test
